title: Own the Machine: a draft EU Regulation on citizens' participation in automated productivity gains
description: A complete draft EU Regulation, with explanatory memorandum, objections file and evidence base, requiring undertakings whose output is substantially decoupled from employment to issue, once, a non-voting warrant over 3 % of their fully diluted capital to a European Citizens' Capital Reserve held for all Union citizens. Drafted in the open as the basis for a possible European Citizens' Initiative; every review verdict, failed rounds included, is committed alongside the text. The living draft and its five-language site are at ownthemachine.eu; this deposit is a fixed, citable version. The Software Heritage snapshot identifiers for the same content are recorded in ARCHIVAL.md.
